text:
Two salmon pieces with skin, topped with red pepper strips, scallions and sprouts. The square plate is about 26 cm across, so the salmon is roughly 10x6 cm in total, about 2 cm thick, giving around 130 g of salmon. At about 2 kcal/g for pan-seared salmon with oil, that's roughly 270 kcal. The peppers, greens and sprouts add about 30 g and 15 kcal.
